name: Agent work queue
blurb: A dependency-aware issue queue for coding agents, in the style of beads: file work, link what waits on what, claim what is ready, close it.

questions.q: What can an agent claim now?
What is blocked, and by what?
Which blocks does an issue inherit from its parents?
What depends on this issue, directly or not?

search.title: Agent work queue: shared state for coding agents
